name: Markdown Plugin
description: Tabbed Markdown preview viewer. Loads .md files via electronAPI.fs.readFile, renders them to styled HTML using the 'marked' library with a custom Renderer that escapes raw HTML and prevents javascript: links. Supports multiple tabs with drag-and-drop reorder, close buttons, middle-click close, right-click context menu (Close/Close Others/Close All/Copy Path), external file change auto-reload preserving scroll position, and serializable state (open files, active file, per-tab scroll positions) for session persistence.

dependencies.usage: Opens right-click context menu on tabs with close/reorder/copy-path actions

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Builds tab bar, preview area, wires file change listener

methods.name: loadFile
methods.description: Loads a .md file, creates a tab, switches to it, renders preview

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns serializable state: open files, active file, per-tab scroll positions

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores tabs and scroll positions from saved state, includes legacy single-file format support
